# qbittorrent_preferences (Resource)

Singleton partial ownership of application preferences. Configure only settings to manage. Removing an attribute relinquishes management without resetting it. Import ID: application; import reads the server without claiming unconfigured settings. Destroy removes state only. Use one instance per server; overlapping ownership is unsupported. Read-after-write reports normalized/rejected fields: use server-normalized paths.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "qbittorrent_preferences" "application" {
  save_path         = "/downloads"
  temp_path         = "/downloads/incomplete"
  temp_path_enabled = true
  auto_tmm_enabled  = false
  dl_limit          = 0
  up_limit          = 1048576
  dht               = false
  pex               = false
  lsd               = false
  listen_port       = 6881
  upnp              = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `alt_dl_limit` (Number) Alternate download limit in bytes/s; 0 means unlimited. Rate limits must be multiples of 1024, at most 2147482624.
- `alt_up_limit` (Number) Alternate upload limit in bytes/s; 0 means unlimited. Rate limits must be multiples of 1024, at most 2147482624.
- `auto_tmm_enabled` (Boolean) Enable automatic torrent management by default. Changes may relocate files.
- `dht` (Boolean) Enable DHT.
- `dl_limit` (Number) Global download limit in bytes/s; 0 means unlimited. Rate limits must be multiples of 1024, at most 2147482624.
- `listen_port` (Number) Incoming listen port, 1..65535. Disable random-port settings on the server before managing this field.
- `lsd` (Boolean) Enable local service discovery.
- `pex` (Boolean) Enable peer exchange.
- `save_path` (String) Default save path on the server. Use a normalized absolute path.
- `temp_path` (String) Incomplete-download path on the server. Use a normalized absolute path.
- `temp_path_enabled` (Boolean) Enable the incomplete-download path.
- `up_limit` (Number) Global upload limit in bytes/s; 0 means unlimited. Rate limits must be multiples of 1024, at most 2147482624.
- `upnp` (Boolean) Enable UPnP/NAT-PMP port forwarding.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Singleton ID: application.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import qbittorrent_preferences.application application
```
